headword: {結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}
gloss: marriage hunting; actively seeking a spouse

definitions.gloss: marriage hunting; actively seeking a spouse
definitions.explanation: Deliberate effort to find a marriage partner, such as attending matchmaking events, using dating services, or being introduced to prospects. The full form of the common abbreviation {婚活|こんかつ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: My sister has started marriage hunting.

examples.japanese: {結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談所|そうだんじょ}→相談所：29058_soudanjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}した→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I registered with an agency for my marriage hunting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: I'm so busy with work that I can hardly find time for marriage hunting.

notes:
The full form of ⟦{婚活|こんかつ}→婚活：05833_konkatsu⟧, formed from ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧ (marriage) + ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (activity), on the model of ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧ (job hunting). In everyday use the abbreviation ⟦{婚活|こんかつ}→婚活：05833_konkatsu⟧ is far more common; the full form sounds slightly more formal or explanatory.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める: to start marriage hunting
- {結婚活動|けっこんかつどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}む→励む：11822_hagemu⟧: to work hard at finding a spouse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{婚活|こんかつ}→婚活：05833_konkatsu⟧: marriage hunting — the standard abbreviation; identical meaning
- ⟦{就活|しゅうかつ}→就活：05832_shuukatsu⟧: job hunting — the parallel abbreviation for finding employment
